input.contract: graph maps string node to iterable of prerequisite node strings. targets is an iterable of node strings. Return the sorted list of all nodes that are in targets or are transitive prerequisites of any target. Include prerequisite-only nodes. Raise ValueError if any target is not a key in graph.

description: Compute the set of nodes reachable from a given target set in a dependency graph, including the targets themselves and all their transitive prerequisites.
requirements: Submit exactly one self-contained Python function file; standard library only; no I/O, network, project imports, or input mutation.
